description: Opus self-assessment not run on same self-contained context as routed providers. Spec Step 2 says 'identical and self-contained across all three reviewers; assume each reviewer has no prior context'; documented deviation does not close the compliance gap.
fix_notes: Operator-confirmed defer (Option 1 of 3 in the user choice). Rationale: spec Step 2 and Step 3 carry conflicting requirements (Step 3 explicitly cites 'the orchestrator already has the full context loaded' as the reason for self-contribution, which contradicts Step 2's 'no prior context' clause). The orchestrator-self-contribution pattern documented in feedback_orchestrator_self_contributes_to_review_panel was designed precisely to leverage the orchestrator's full context. Re-doing Opus's assessment under strict prompt-only constraint would dismantle the pattern (functionally equivalent to routing Opus->Opus, which is what the feedback memory specifically advises against). This is a spec-revision item for Step 9 reorganization review, not a session-4-internal fix. Surfaced in disposition.json for the closeout gate; preserved in the synthesis section 9 methodology notes for future spec-author reference.
